evidence.title: Malad West Overview
evidence.description: Malad West is a well-known and upscale residential neighbourhood in the western suburbs, located on the western line of the Mumbai Suburban Railway. It is a green and peaceful neighbourhood located along Malad Creek and surrounded by mangroves. The residential development in Malad West consists primarily of multi-story apartments and villas and is motivated by its proximity to Orlem, Evershine Nagar, Chincholi Bunder, Mindspace, and other IT parks, as well as its excellent connectivity to the rest of Mumbai. It is also near other well-known areas in western Mumbai, including Malad East, Kandivali West, and Goregaon West. Many completed high-rise residential projects in the area include Transcon Auris Serenity, Shreeji Atlantis, Royal Oasis, Sheth Irene, and Gurukrupa Marina Enclave.
